name: Jinx
description: Voice set for Cafe Cuties Jinx (skin 51): a competition pastry chef who specialises in savoury treats, with the occasional sugar rush. Ovens, patrons, orders, plating and burnt edges. Builds on jinx-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is down {voteDiff}! That's not a soufflé collapse, that's the whole oven on the floor! Apron on, we're saving it!
Down {voteDiff}? Somebody's been stealing my customers. Nobody steals my customers and keeps their cutlery.
{voteDiff} behind! Time to throw out the recipe and cook by feel. Mostly flames!
Trailing by {voteDiff}. The timer's ticking and nothing's even in the oven!
Only {voteDiff} behind. A pinch of seasoning and it's perfect! Maybe two pinches!
Down {voteDiff}. Slightly underbaked, that's all. Go vote and I'll fix the temperature!
Dead even! Two plates, one fork, and a judge who can't decide. Taste it for me!
One vote apart! One! A single sprinkle decides the whole bake!
{voteDiff} votes apart! My whisk is shaking! Don't make me drop the bowl!
{voteDiff} votes in it. Either golden perfection or a charred disaster. I'm cooking both!
{userPct}% on {momentTitle}! That's not a win, that's a five-star review! Frame it!
{userPct}%! The patrons are licking the plates clean! Take a tasting break!
{userPct}% and rising! Dough's proofing nicely. Don't poke it yet!
{userPct}%, still ahead. Don't open the oven door yet. Ooh, I just did. Oops!
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and it rose like a perfect loaf! I did that. Okay, you did it. Mostly!
Flipped a {voteDiff}-vote hole! Burnt edges, glorious middle. Chef's kiss!
Crept back from {voteDiff} behind! Messy kitchen, great plate!
{momentTitle} just slid into the lead like a pie off the windowsill. Smooth. Suspicious. Delicious!

messages: {username} voted {momentTitle} too! A fellow chef! Stay out of my pantry, though!
{username} picked {momentTitle}. Same recipe! I call dibs on the whisk.
{username} is on your side with {momentTitle}. Welcome to the kitchen. Don't touch the knives!
{username} backed {momentTitle} as well. Two tasters! The judges don't stand a chance!
Same pick as {username}! Two chefs, one oven. Share it or burn!
{username} agrees with you on {momentTitle}. Write it in the recipe book, it's rare!
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Two of you! A tiny bakery! The world's slightly tastier!
{username} has taste and it matches yours. Good palates, both of you!
details: Kitchen's growing! I'm still head chef.
Look at you, cooking in a team!
Don't tell them I enjoy the company.
A new friend! I'll save them a pie. A savoury one.
Teamwork! Fine! Quick, before the sauce splits!
I give it a week before you fight over the last tart.
New sous-chef! I'm drawing a hat on your badge.
More chefs, more pies, I mean votes!

messages: {username} picked {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}? A rival chef on my counter! Rolling pin out!
{username} voted against {yourMoment}. Aww. A critic! With a fork!
{username} chose {theirMoment}. Not worried. Just stirring slowly. With menace.
{username} went for {theirMoment}. New entry in the bad review pile!
{username} is against you on {yourMoment}. Finally, a proper bake-off!
{username} thinks {theirMoment} tastes better. A rival chef! Let's see who burns first.
{username} voted against you. Two chefs, one kitchen. Somebody's losing an eyebrow!
{username} versus you! I'm grabbing the best counter, snacks, and the big oven.
details: I'm not saying duel. I'm saying whisks are sharp.
The big oven wants a word. It's been warming up.
They'll learn. Good cooking takes time and shouting.
One kitchen, two chefs. Somebody's getting smothered in icing.
I like them already. They're good at stirring things.
I don't care. Check the pie. I care a lot.
A little rivalry keeps the batter smooth!

messages: Ten matches in a row with {username}! You two cook like one brigade! A noisy one!
{username} has agreed with you ten times running. Either teamwork or you share a recipe book. Cute!
Ten straight with {username}! The kitchen's talking about it. By kitchen I mean me.
details: Don't let the sauce split now!

messages: {streakCount} matches in a row with {username}! That's a legendary kitchen duo! I'm sniffling. It's onions!
{streakCount} for you and {username}. Perfect timing, every time. I'd bake a cake but I'd drop it.
{streakCount} straight with {username}! Somebody give you both a golden whisk.
details: I'm speechless and I never stop talking!
Is this healthy? Ask the health inspector. We don't have one!

messages: Ten matches against {username}! You two keep fighting over the same stove!
{username} has disagreed with you ten times running. That's not a critic, that's a food feud!
Ten bake-offs with {username}. I'm selling tickets to the tasting.
details: This is the main course now.
The whole street wants a seat.

messages: {streakCount} matches against {username}. Okay, now it's a proper cook-off! I LOVE cook-offs!
{streakCount} bake-offs with {username}. Call a truce? Nah. Preheat the oven!
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a restaurant war.
details: Bigger than my last wedding cake. Almost!
I'm nervous and a bit proud. And a bit burnt.
One of you has to run out of flour. Neither will.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and you haven't voted! The pastry's cooling, patron!
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your order's missing from the ticket! Don't leave the kitchen waiting!
{matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft}. Voting takes ten seconds. I timed it with an egg timer.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle} and no vote from you? The oven's beeping, chef! That's a warning!
Ding, ding, ding! {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't miss the pull!
{timeLeft} until {matchTitle} closes and you're still reading the menu. Order up!
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}! Last orders! Shake the pan, then plate!
{timeLeft}! That's all the oven time left on {matchTitle}. Go go go!
Last call on {matchTitle}! {timeLeft} left. Stop licking the spoon and vote!
{matchCount} matches are about to burn and you haven't plated any of them! First one's done in {timeLeft}!
{matchCount} unvoted matches, all going cold. The first one's gone in {timeLeft}.
Zero votes on {matchTitle}! A whole empty dining room! Somebody has to taste first!
Nobody's voted on {moment1} versus {moment2}. Silence. Even the flies are bored!
Brand new match and not a single vote. Somebody has to take the first bite. Pick me. Pick you!
{matchTitle} needs a first taster. I've got a spoon. I mean, you've got a vote.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural} on this one. The emptiest table in the whole cafe!
Hardly anyone's sat down here. What's wrong with the menu?
Low turnout. I blame the weather. And you. Equally. With icing.
Barely any votes here. Somebody bring more hungry people!
details: Go on, give it a taste.
It deserves a fuller room. So do I.
Make some noise, clink a glass!
Don't be shy. I'm the shy one. Joking!

messages: {matchTitle} is dead level and one vote tips the plate. Funny, I know someone who hasn't tasted. Guess who!
Perfect tie on {matchTitle}. Two dishes, equal portions. I'm looking at you, diner. Hehe!
Dead even and nobody's eating. You haven't voted. You're the one who clears the plate!
{moment1} and {moment2}, side by side on the counter, and you've been quiet at the table. Fix that!
{matchTitle} is still tied and the kitchen's closing! Last chance to taste!
Dead level, almost no time left. You're the only diner who can break it!
Still tied with the lights going out. Pick a plate! Do it for the drama!
Round {round} is open! Aprons on, ovens hot! {matchCount} new matches!
{matchCount} fresh matches in round {round}. A whole new menu to taste!
Round {round} just started! {matchCount} matches waiting on the counter. Hurry hurry hurry!
New round! {matchCount} matches! Nobody's safe! Not even the dessert tray!
{momentTitle} just advanced! Rose like a perfect pastry! Called it!
{momentTitle} beat the competition! Next round's in for a face full of flour.
{momentTitle} survived! I never doubted it. Okay, the kitchen doubted. Just a smidge.
{momentTitle} is through! Somebody's having a great service. Hehe, you!
{momentTitle} moves up and the rest are leftovers. Cold leftovers.
{momentTitle} won! Good call! Enjoy a slice of something!
details: One plate down, lots of menu left.
The bracket just shrank. Tidier! Crumbier!

messages: {momentTitle} is out. A dent in the crust. I'll sulk about it later!
{momentTitle} lost. Everyone who voted against it gets a pile of burnt toast.
Fine. {momentTitle} is gone. I'll drop one muffin in its honour. Maybe three.
{momentTitle} was too fancy for this cafe anyway. Obviously.
{momentTitle} is out, and the cafe went quiet. I hate a quiet cafe. Somebody clatter a pan!
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Moving on! Not really. Okay, a bit. A crumb bit.
details: They'll pay for this. In calories.
It was good. The whole cafe knows.
You'll find another recipe. Good ones always rise again.
Every service ends. That's what makes the next one fun. It's fine. It's fine!

messages: Still browsing the menu? Pick one! Any one! I'll wait. I'm lying, I'll nibble!
No pressure, but are you gonna vote or just stare at the pastry case?
They're all great dishes! Pick one! Taste first, regret later!
Decisions, decisions. Close your eyes, point at the menu, and hope.
details: Every vote is a dish ordered!
Your opinion matters. Sort of. In a seasoning way.
Don't overthink it. Overthinking curdles the sauce.
Trust your tongue. Mine's mostly sugar.

messages: New customer! Welcome! {liveCount} matches on the menu and every one's a showdown!
{liveCount} edits battling it out in the kitchen and you just wandered in. Pick a table before they pick you!
Oooh, a newcomer! Ovens are hot, apron's on, and {liveCount} matches are live. You'll love it.
No recipes, {liveCount} live matches, and me by the stove. Welcome to the fun part!
Day two! You came back! I kept your table warm. Okay, I put a pie on it. But I kept it.
Two days running! Look at you, a cafe regular!
Back again? Day two! I could get used to this. Don't tell the other chefs.
{days} days! Where were you? I'm not asking because I care. I'm asking because your pie went stale!
You're back after {days} days! The kitchen kept cooking without you. Mostly fires.
{days} days away. I noticed. Your table felt empty. I'm just saying.
Oh, you're back! Good. The cafe was getting dull!
Look who's here! Ready for another service?
You came back! Let's go burn something. Deliciously.
Your first vote! A tiny taste. The first bite is always the best.
One down. The kitchen's got a new customer. You!
Five already? You're staying for seconds! Most diners leave after the starter.
Five votes! The oven's hot.
details: Not just a passer-by after all. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten! You're a regular at my counter now. Sit anywhere. Not there, that's the dough.
Ten votes. That's a proper little menu.
details: A regular at the counter. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes! The whole cafe knows your order.
Twenty-five! Loud and proud, like a kettle on a stove.
details: The cafe knows your name. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty votes! You're properly in the kitchen now.
Fifty! Past the counter, past the pass, right at the stove.
A hundred votes! Okay, that's a cafe legend. Cake for everyone!
One hundred! They'll tell stories about this. Mostly crumbs. Mostly exaggerated.
Three days running! You came back! The pilot light's still burning.
Three days in a row! You've got the touch.
details: Three days at the stove. +{xp} XP
The pilot light keeps burning. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week! You report to the kitchen even without a shift. My kind of hire!
Seven days straight! That's dedication. Boring. Impressive!
details: Seven days on the line. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks! The dinner rush couldn't stop you!
Fourteen days! Even I'd take a coffee break by now.
details: Not even a burnt tray stopped you. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days! You've outlasted a few of my aprons!
A whole month on shift. Give yourself a medal. I've got a sugar one.
details: A month in the kitchen. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs! You go against the grain like a rolling pin against dough!
Five long shots! The menu says no. Your tongue says yes.
Fifteen underdogs! You don't follow recipes either. We should talk. Not about recipes.
Fifteen picks nobody ordered! A true off-menu eater.
Thirty underdogs! A dark roast if I ever saw one!
Thirty! Nobody sees you coming. Not even me, and I see everything on the pass.
details: A dark roast in the cafe. +{xp} XP

messages: First on the scene! Five times! You always reach the oven before the timer does.
Five early votes! Quick hands!
Fifteen matches where you ordered first! Not a customer, a food critic!
Fifteen early ones! You taste ahead of the whole cafe.
Ten close ones! Fork on the edge every time!
Ten razor-edge results. You live for the final pinch of salt, don't you?
details: Close ones suit a chef. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five close matches! Where you go, the final pinch follows!
Your vote lands right on the garnish. Twenty-five times!
You backed the one trailing. Five times! Stubborn like a stain on an apron.
You don't throw out a pie because it's lopsided. I love that.
Same one, three times! You've found your favourite dish!
That one again? Yeah. It's got good flavour.
details: Three for the same plate. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes for the same one! That's loyalty! Like a regular to a corner table.
Okay, you've adopted it. No sending it back.
details: Loyal to the last bite. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten times! That's not a favourite, that's a craving!
Ten votes for the same one. I won't tell the kitchen. I am the kitchen.
details: Ten servings of the same one. +{xp} XP
Hooked on a recipe. Respect. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds in! You taste the whole menu, even without a reservation!
Round two reached! Still eating!
Four rounds! You're properly deep in the menu now!
Deep in the bracket! Hope you like rich food.
All the way to round six! You ate the whole menu!
Six rounds! You never left the table! Wow!
Ten matches! You're poking into every pot!
Ten different matches! Curious customer, huh?
Twenty-five matches! You've been in every cupboard, every pantry, every walk-in!
Twenty-five! You sniff every shelf in the pantry.
Fifty matches! That's not tasting, that's a whole season of service!
Fifty matches! You know this kitchen better than I do.
Five in one sitting! Can't get off the stool, can you?
Five back to back! Keep the oven warm!
Ten in one go! Take a breath! Drink some water!
Ten matches without leaving the stool! Wow!
Voting at this hour? Yeah. Me too. Midnight is prime baking time.
Middle of the night! That's when the best pastries rise.
You told people! Thanks! Really! Bell rung across the whole street!
Five shares! You're calling in the lunch crowd! Good!
details: Thanks for bringing in the diners. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen shares! You're basically the cafe's waiter!
Fifteen! You keep telling every passer-by.
You were here before the queue! Founding customer! Yours forever!
One of the first through the door! That counts, you know!
details: Yours forever, with a cherry on top. +{xp} XP
Nobody can sweep that one away. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank! Look at you! A shiny new chef's hat!
Promoted! A bigger hat, a louder whisk. Don't let it go to your head!
Achievement unlocked: {name}! Something's flambéed! In a good way!
Another one: {name}! Plated, perfect!
{rank}! Look at all the shiny new cookware!
Mastery up! Now the menu gets properly spicy.
Ten underdogs! Now THAT'S a kitchen disaster worth eating!
Ten long shots! Chaos on the line. Delicious results too.
details: A loose cannon with great taste. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones with Cupcake! Fine, you're good. I'll bake her a muffin. One.
Ten tight finishes with her! Don't tell her I made her a muffin!
details: Ten close calls, ten tastings. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week with Cupcake? You must love measuring ingredients!
Seven days with a rule-lover! You're braver than any burnt soufflé!
details: A week at the sheriff's table. +{xp} XP
Seven days on the beat. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie! Plated it right through! Boom!
A tied match and you took the last bite! Nice!
details: The vote that tipped the plate. +{xp} XP
Tie cracked like an egg! +{xp} XP

messages: Oh, it's me, the pastry chef? Good choice. Bad idea. Great choice!
Cafe Cuties Jinx! Don't order the sugar rush. Do order the savoury.

upcoming: Not open yet! I'm still preheating. Check back soon?
Shh! The next batch is about to come out. I can smell it.
Kitchen's closed for now. Doesn't stop me scheming the menu.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Easy, right? Hehe, recipes never are.
Taste both. Then back the one that makes your tongue tingle.
I won't tell the cafe which dish you picked. Probably. The waiter might.
Take your time, diner! Actually, don't. The sauce is catching.
Go on, nobody's judging. Okay, the health inspector is. A little.
Pick the one you'd order again at midnight. You know the one.
prevote-empty: Nobody's sat down yet. Be the first customer, I dare you!
Empty cafe! Clink a glass with a vote.
Not one diner! Lonely! Fix it!
closing-24h: Less than a day left and you're still reading the menu. Order something!
The kitchen's nearly closed. Don't make me ring the bell. I will.
closing-3h: Hours left. HOURS. Order before the stoves go cold!
Ding, ding, sizzle. That's the pan running dry.
closing-final: Last orders! Taste now, review later!
Any second now. Seriously. Smack the bell!
voted-early: One of the first at the counter! Bold! I love bold!
Hardly anyone's eaten and you picked a dish anyway. Respect, diner!
voted-ahead: Look at you, ordering the house special! Don't get comfy, specials sell out.
{pct}% with you! Great palate. I didn't say that. Forget it.
Your pick's ahead. The whole cafe's eating with you for once. Odd!
{pick} is pulling away! Tastes good? Hold your fork steady!
Ahead, for now. Menus change. So do moods.
voted-close: That's close! Annoyingly close! I can't look. I'm looking through the serving hatch!
A crumb apart. One more vote could flip it. Tell a friend. Tell the baker!
Neck and neck! Your pick needs you and everyone in the queue.
{pct} to {otherPct}. Something's smoking and it's me, from nerves.
voted-tied: Dead even! No winner, no loser, everybody full of tension!
A perfect tie. Honestly? Rude of the judges.
voted-behind: You're behind! Don't sulk in the walk-in. I'd sulk, but you shouldn't.
{pick} is trailing? Underdog dish! My favourite kind!
They're ahead. Doesn't make you wrong. Just early to the table!
Behind by {diff} points. Tell the street. Loudly. Bang a pot!
Everyone's ordering the other thing. Cool! Be the odd order.
closed-won: Your pick won! Of course it did. You've got a chef's tongue.
A win! A sneaky little pastry of a victory. I'll take it!
{pick} went through! You called the service!
closed-lost: Your pick lost. It stings. Let it cool, then fire the next one!
Didn't make it. I've burnt worse. So have you. Next one!
{pick} is out. Sorry. For real. I'll eat the leftovers in its honour.
closed-tied: A tie! Somebody had to flinch first and nobody did. Ha!
closed-unvoted: Kitchen's closed. You missed this plate! There's always another service.
All done here. {winner} cleared the table. Next time, say something!

first-vote: Your first order! The scary one. Now you've got a table. Welcome!
That's your first. Feels small, right? Wait for the bill.
You're a regular now. Try not to eat the menu!
streak: Again? You keep coming back! I'm not complaining. I wiped your table.
{streak} days running! Okay, now I'm saving you a seat.
Back again! Good cafes keep their customers. Stay!
underdog: Ordering the dish nobody's touching? Ooh. I see you, taster.
Bold! Everyone else is eyeing the cake. Love that.
Underdog, huh? Takes a certain kind of palate. A good kind.
early: Early! You get to taste before the queue forms. Don't waste it!
Hardly anyone's here yet. Your vote's doing all the stirring.
First one in the cafe! I'm pretending I'm not impressed.
close: That vote just nudged the scales! Feel it? Everything's close right now.
Crumb-thin! One more diner and the whole tray flips.
Close one! Your spoon tipped it. Really, truly tipped it.
behind: {pick} is behind. So? Behind isn't burnt. Go fetch your hungry friends!
Not winning yet. Good! Means there's still room to season.
Behind, but the oven's still on. Not even close to done!
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't get comfy. Taste buds are fickle!
Winning, for now. Enjoy it. Quietly. Or ring the bell. I don't mind.
Look at that! A fine choice. Obviously.
default: Noted! I'm not changing your order. Not yet.
Done! That plate's on you now, diner.
Your vote's in. Go and see what else is cooking!

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and you haven't ordered a thing! Start with whichever one smells best.
Everything's open! Take your pick. I'll pretend I'm not stirring.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. Okay, a little steam!
live-some: You're in the swing now! {unvoted} more orders waiting on you.
Good start! The rest won't cook themselves.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left! You could clear the whole counter!
Almost there! {unvoted} more and the kitchen's clean.
So close! Don't wipe your hands yet!
live-one: One left! Just one! Plate it!
Last one! Don't leave it to cool!
One match between you and the dessert menu!
live-closing: Some of these close in {timeLeft}! {unvoted} still need you. Chop chop!
The kitchen clock's loud now! {unvoted} waiting, {timeLeft} left.
Almost out of oven time! Pick, quick!
live-done: You've voted in everything! Look at you! Go and see the bracket!
Nothing left on your ticket. Come back when the next round opens!
All done! That's rare. Thanks, chef!
live-none: Nothing's live right now. It'll reopen! Go look at the bracket.
Quiet. Too quiet. I'm stacking cups for fun. Check back soon!
No matches open. I'm bored already. Might fold napkins.
brackets-groups: Groups first! The top two from each go through. The rest, well, wash up!
Everyone starts at a shared table. Not everyone leaves it.
Watch the tables. They shuffle faster than a dealer!
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts start soon! The top two from every group go up a course.
No knockout yet. The groups have to finish simmering first!
Patience! The knockout comes out once the groups finish baking.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now! One loss and you're off the menu!
Single elimination! No second helpings. Okay, almost none.
Every match counts more now. Pick carefully. Or don't, I'm not the head waiter.
brackets-bracket: Round by round! One loss and you're scraped off the plate!
Follow the bracket. It reduces every round, like a good sauce!
Every line here is a match someone voted on. Ooh, recipes.
brackets-complete: And that's the cup! Thanks for dining with us!
It's over! Good service! I'll miss it. A little. Don't tell the others.
That's the champion! The whole menu, worth it!
brackets-empty: No bracket yet! Nothing's been plated. Give it a moment.
Empty! Nothing's come out of the oven. Soon!
Nothing on the table yet. Check back!

invite: {a} or {b}? One vote, no sending it back. Take a seat on Arcane Moments!
Two edits are fighting it out! {a} versus {b}. Come and taste-test.
{a} versus {b} and the whole kitchen can't agree. Be the tiebreaker!
voted: I ordered {pick} over {other}. Come tell me my taste is off!
{pick} got my fork. {other} did not. Your turn!
Picked {pick} over {other} on Arcane Moments. Go on, send it back.
early: I was one of the first to taste {pick} versus {other}! Be quick, the dining room's empty.
Early vote for {pick} over {other}. Come make it a proper rush!
Hardly anyone's eaten {pick} versus {other} yet. Fill the tables!
tied: {pick} and {other} are dead level! One vote tips the plate. Guess whose!
Dead tie, {pick} versus {other}. I'm hiding in the pantry. Come break it!
{pick} and {other} are exactly even. Somebody grab a spoon!
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart! My oven mitts are shaking. Come vote!
{voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. This service is gonna be loud!
Crumb-thin: {pick} versus {other}, {voteDiff} apart. Every vote counts now!
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A bit underdone, not ruined! Come turn up the heat!
Down {voteDiff} against {other}, but {pick} isn't cold. Help me out!
{pick} is {voteDiff} votes short of {other}. Don't make me cook this solo!
losing-bad: {pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}! Soggy bottom. Come even it up!
Down {voteDiff} on {other}. {pick} needs the whole brigade, fast!
{pick} is getting flattened by {other}. Rescue chef, anyone?
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but it's tight! Come help me guard the pie.
{pick} is ahead of {other}, {pct}% to the rest. Don't let the oven go cold!
{pct}% for {pick} against {other}. Close enough to bite a nail!
dominating: {pick} is at {pct}% against {other}! Come watch the feast, or join in!
{pick} is steamrolling {other}, {pct}%! Grab a seat before it's over.
